name: 時間帯を示すメッセージ予約送信
prompt:
Refine candidate 1 into a faithful static Japanese schedule-message sheet. Final canvas aspect ratio 390×472 (portrait). Use the original source crop for geometry and colors, the Japanese native preview for exact localized copy, and candidate 1 only as the current draft to correct.

Keep only the white sheet, its rounded top corners, short centered gray drag handle, header, dividers, two options, five-row date/time wheel, and bottom button. No background, phone chrome, branding, drop shadow, or decorative texture.

Exact copy: title 「送信日時を予約」; gray subtitle 「時刻は日本標準時です」; first option 「月曜日の9:00」; second option 「日時を指定」. Wheel columns and rows exactly:
「5月30日(木)」 | 10 | 58 | 午前
「昨日」 | 11 | 59 | 午前
selected 「6月1日(土)」 | 12 | 00 | 午後
「6月2日(日)」 | 1 | 01 | 午後
「6月3日(月)」 | 2 | 02 | 午後
button 「送信を予約」.

Correct candidate 1's proportions: title should be about 15px high at 390px canvas width, subtitle about 12px; option labels around 16–17px. Make the top header more compact, with the first divider around y=76, first option centered around y=104, second divider around y=136, custom option around y=175. Center the five wheel rows evenly with roughly 29px between row centers, around y=230, 259, 288, 317, and 346. Keep the selected band around 342px wide and 33px high, centered across the selected row, with a neutral light gray fill (#f2f2f2). Use softly faded gray adjacent rows and bold near-black selected values.

The bottom button must be a perfectly uniform solid Slack green (#047857): no gradient, lighting, texture, highlight, shadow, or color variation. Match original source proportions: about 365px wide and 43px high, rounded corners, near the bottom edge. Use exact white label. No hyperlinks are present, so no blue text.

Preserve the source's clean white surface and flat colors; no misty gray shading. Static image only; no animation cues.
reviewNotes: Candidate 2 retains exact Japanese copy and the source gray selection band; no hyperlink is present. The title/options and lower wheel spacing still differ, and button shading remains after two attempts. Retain needs-correction.
